title: CINCLANT Code Zebra alert over object off Newfoundland
place_text: Atlantic Command, Norfolk, Virginia; off Newfoundland

tellings.quote: he was uh working under Sync Atlantic Command, the commander-in-chief Atlantic Command in Norfolk and they went to a full code zebra alert,

plain: Sometime in the 1980s, an unknown object off Newfoundland is said to have put the US Navy's Atlantic Command in Norfolk, Virginia, on a full alert called "code zebra." Steven Greer tells Michels this as it was told to him by Merle Shane McDow, who was "working under" the commander-in-chief of that command and names Admiral Harry Train in the story, and Greer credits the book Disclosure: An Illustrated History. If true, a major US military command treated a UFO as a real threat.
